lines: With hardly any music at all
we spent those days together again, the two of us
a love song on our fingers
tonight too, we walk together
becoming two, waiting for you
I remembered
when I grew up
the one I'll remember won't be anyone but you, will it — back then
our bond, softly, flight
we've entwined each other's fingers, and now
Napori, I want to stay like this forever
gazing at each other here, we both breathe easy
Oh right, oh right, oh right
we keep entwining
Oh right, oh right, oh right
naturally, on a night like this, coffee would be right
beside me like that, you take a sip of your highball
how should I put it
when I look at you
even without a drop to drink
the buzz comes over me
becoming sound, growing up
I remembered
when you grew up
the one you'll remember won't be anyone but me, will it
